'''Klef''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived with his family in the [[Gnawer's Roost]] district of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and who worked as a bartender in the [[Invisible Hand cantina]]. When the cantina became the site of a shootout between the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agent [[Tavik Moern]] and some [[Quarren/Legends|Quarrens]] against the [[Alderaanian Resistance]], Klef ducked behind the bar and remained there until it was safe.

He could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Gran (language)/Legends|Gran]], [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], [[Quarrenese/Legends|Quarrenese]] and [[Skakoverbal/Legends|Skakoverbal]].
